title: Drake Visited Bun B's Trill Burgers Recently And Dubbed It Best Burger He's Ever Had [Watch]
htmlContent:
If you needed any more convincing to try Bun B's Trill Burgers, just take it from Drake himself. The multi-talented rapper, singer, and songwriter recently paid a visit to the popular burger joint located in the Montrose area and declared it to be "the best burger I've ever had." Coming from someone who knows a thing or two about being the best, it's high praise indeed.

Drake took to his Instagram story to share a video of his experience at Trill Burgers, sitting across from his "mentor" Bun B, the co-founder of the establishment. Bun B expressed his admiration for Drake, stating that he's one of the biggest celebrities the restaurant has seen. While Trill Burgers has attracted its fair share of famous clientele since its grand opening at the beginning of the month, including Ludacris, Slim Thug, and Andre Johnson, Drake's visit truly elevated its reputation.

Since opening its doors in June, Trill Burgers has garnered immense popularity, with hundreds of customers lining up daily. The long lines and social media reviews have already piqued the curiosity of many, but Drake's endorsement adds an extra level of excitement. While Trill Burgers currently operates as an extended pop-up spot, the team is actively searching for a permanent home in Houston to continue serving their mouthwatering creations to a growing fan base. So, if you're seeking an exceptional burger experience, it's clear that Trill Burgers is the place to be, as confirmed by the discerning taste of Drake himself.
